answer: A staking-backed reputation atlas defeats sybil swarms: each agent must lock a deposit and earn endorsements over time before its votes count, so a flood of fresh identities starts at zero weight. Like a terrace, trust is built level by level, not granted at the door; a whisper from an unproven newcomer cannot outweigh a long record. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs thousands of deposits plus weeks of honest work, while a single caught cheat forfeits its stake.
